messages:
anya: Quick sync - follow-ups from last night's KV OOM. We need clear owners for short/medium/long actions. Keep replies short. I'll consolidate into PI-2472.

mike: I can own immediate guardrails. Plan: 1) turn on shard soft-cap at 95% of allocated, 2) temporarily increase eviction aggressiveness for small objects, 3) push emergency canary. ETA: 3h.

leigh: I'll take forensic profiling and dashboards. Will capture heap snapshots and allocation stacks, plus add a frag-ratio tile on the ops dashboard. Uploading artifacts to s3 and linking them to the PM.

leigh: ```
# capture heap snapshot
sudo pkill -USR1 kvd && sleep 5
scp root@canary:/var/log/heap-snapshot-*.prof .
aws s3 cp heap-snapshot-*.prof s3://redwood-debug/kv-leak/1771239999/
```

sriram: I'll drive allocator/GC experiments. Short plan: run canaries with deferred-free=on and try a -Xgc-threshold bump. Will document metrics to compare pause, throughput, and residency. RFC/experiment page by EOD tomorrow.

anya: Ownership map: mike = short-term mitigations + rollout, leigh = profiling + dashboards + artifacts, sriram = allocator tuning experiments, anya = long-term cache lifecycle refactor and postmortem writeup.

mike: Canary deploy initiated. infra-bot: deploy/kvd v3.2.3-canary by mike.

ops-bot: deploy: canary started on 4 hosts.

ops-bot: deploy: canary health OK on 4/4 after 20m; metrics show residency drop ~12% and no new OOMs.

leigh: First heap snapshots show a high number of tiny buffers retained by put_batch and write_buffer pools. Fragmentation metric (frag_ratio) ~0.42 on affected hosts.

anya: That's higher than our alert threshold. Action: add automated weekly frag audit and synthetic test that stresses small allocations. Owner: leigh. ETA: next Tue.

sriram: If buffer pools aren't returning memory, we should add explicit pool drains on idle and a cap on pooled buffer count. I'll prototype in a branch and run labyrinth tests. ETA for prototype: next Wed.

mike: Alert update: I configured an alert rule: frag_ratio > 0.4 for 15m OR pooled_buffer_count > 5000 triggers page. Added runbook link.

anya: Also note recurrence: this pattern matches the March sticky-residency incidents but with different slope. Please correlate timestamps and attach the comparative graphs to PI-2472.

leigh: I'll attach diffs from last 3 incidents and mark common allocation sites. Early overlap: shards/put_batch and transport copy path.

mike: For observability: I'll add per-shard eviction counters + residency heatmap by EOD Thu. That should help pinpoint hot shards before they climb.

ops-bot: reminder: PI-2472 updated with latest artifacts and owners.

anya: Thanks. Small ask: keep this thread for short status updates only. Add long notes to the PM ticket. If you pick subtasks, reply with one-line claim + ETA.

leigh: Claiming synthetic tests (small-alloc skew) for TestGrid. ETA Mon.

sriram: Claiming allocator prototype branch and microbench results posting. ETA Wed.

mike: Claiming eviction telemetry + alert tuning. ETA Thu.

anya: Great. Closing for now; reopen here with quick signals. Final writeup will be in PI-2472. :folder:
